The name not only symbolizes wealth and power but also emphasizes the concept of stewardship. Prosperity and riches, as represented by the name, were intended to be used responsibly and justly, ensuring the welfare of the community and those in need. Thus, the name 'Ewold' can be viewed as a reminder to use God-given gifts and resources to make a positive impact on others and serve the greater good.
